contract: A library scan emits items_added with an array of the newly created items' old-format expanded documents, in chunks of at most ten (ten then the remainder), to each socket whose user can access at least one of those items and to no other socket; a scan that adds nothing emits no items_added, and a scan requested by a non-admin is rejected without any event.
exceptions: Only the full-library scan call sites (LibraryScanner.js:271,279) are asserted; the event carries no item for libraries with no new files by construction.
force is not applicable: a forced rescan of existing items never adds items, and the scanner adds new files identically with or without the force flag.
